page.overview:
Who is Alia II?

Empress Alia II was Empress of the Known Universe (r. 2411–2441 AG), succeeding her father Kenric III al-Kam as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Alia married Halleck I, who was her co-ruler as emperor from 2413 onwards. In 2441, Halleck succeeded Alia as sole ruler (Alia presumably having died).
